alt_text: AI-generated interpretation of Seville Cathedral and Giralda from Plaza Virgen de los Reyes, with removed azucena finials and localized crown scaffolding, in clear afternoon daylight.
description: The cathedral’s Gothic east end stands left of the Giralda, with the Archbishop’s Palace at the right edge and the fountain-lamp in the plaza foreground. The Giralda’s azucena finials are currently removed for restoration: one group fell in the February storm and the remaining three were removed on 21 February 2026. The central Giraldillo remains. Localized upper-crown scaffolding is depicted using the 3 September report and photograph; its exact arrangement on the scenario date is not independently observed.
